items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: In the week? Kennedy. Is that so? Yeah, I see where I could do it.

ctx.x: It pays to advertise. When did you advertise? Oh, it depends on time. I'd be busy on Sundays. I'd plan out at the lake. You know, picnics. You know, and have a dance Monday night. I'd have a dance in the week. In the week? Kennedy. Is that so? Yeah, I see where I could do it. You see? Just take it late in the afternoon, you know. Where did you play? Catch the people. Huh?
At the lake, where did you play?
